objective.name: sandbox.dsl.foreach.remote.batch
objective.description: Bounded for_each DSL flow over a built collection, targeting a remote wrapper-backed capacity.

#root.role: Build a deterministic batch locally, then iterate over it with bounded concurrency against a remote wrapper-backed echo capacity.

effects.local_wrapper_runtime: A local wrapper builds the batch collection.
effects.external_route: Each batch item crosses the inter-instance boundary toward a remote wrapper-backed capacity.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local batch request becomes an aggregated collection of remote wrapper responses.
invariants: The batch source is produced once by sandbox.build.batch before the loop starts.
The bounded loop preserves item order in the aggregated payload while limiting concurrent remote calls to two.
success: The terminal payload exposes items as the ordered list of downstream sandbox.echo payloads returned by the remote instance.
Each aggregated item carries the message originally generated by sandbox.build.batch for the same index.
failure: The flow fails if sandbox.build.batch fails or if one remote wrapper call fails under the default fail-closed loop policy.
The flow fails if the remote inter-instance route cannot return a terminal wrapper payload.
notes: This scenario validates bounded concurrency in >for_each against a remote wrapper-backed capacity.
The DSL does not create or mutate matters here; it only composes wrapper outputs across the external boundary.
